hazards.text: Numeric aliasing prevents distinguishing pairs by value: PCI_DEVICE_ID_AMD_OPUS_7443 and PCI_DEVICE_ID_AMD_VIPER_7443 both denote 0x7443, and PCI_DEVICE_ID_AMD_GOLAM_7450 and PCI_DEVICE_ID_AMD_8131_BRIDGE both denote 0x7450.

invariants.text: PCI vendor and device identifiers are compile-time 16-bit hexadecimal constants grouped by vendor for device matching and table lookup, with no control flow, locking, allocation or mutable state.
